propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh is a pure shell function that maps (CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) to a vote in {success, failure, cancelled} and must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point with identical behavior.
The existing subprocess contract test tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed from the shell script to the new Python entry point while preserving its full case table.

Direct unit tests must cover the full function contract including pass-through rows (success, failure, cancelled), skipped fallback logic (false->success, true->failure), and fail-closed edge cases (empty/unknown CONCLUSION).
gerrit-verify.yaml must update its sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new Python file and update the run invocation accordingly.
The Python entry point must be dependency-free (stdlib-only) so a single-file sparse-checkout can execute it without package installation.
The shell script must be deleted in the same change to prevent orphaned test references.
